name: Purim
overview: Purim is a feast established by Mordecai to commemorate the deliverance of the Jewish people from the malicious plot of Haman, who sought to destroy them by casting lots, or 'Pur.' The observance involves celebrating the days when the Jews rested from their enemies and the month was transformed from sorrow to joy through feasting, sending gifts to one another, and giving to the poor. This celebration underscores God's providential protection over His people, as seen when King Ahasuerus reversed Haman's evil plan, resulting in Haman and his sons being executed instead.
